title: Bind the complete formal P104 invoice and prove a nonempty valid interval
body:
**Source-binding proof and non-vacuity certificate:** the formal SPEC caller in [PR #7783](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7783) has exactly the complete paid and productive power sums submitted in [PR #7761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7761), for every real exponent. Its `Valid` inequality holds for every `0 <= kappa <= 1/1000`, with margin at least `2432/25`. **No new kappa** or multiplication theorem is claimed.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de1bbd521b121479ffff4b7dfd24b971bf13c877/research/p104-lean-invoice-binding/PROOF.md), [exact certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de1bbd521b121479ffff4b7dfd24b971bf13c877/research/p104-lean-invoice-binding/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de1bbd521b121479ffff4b7dfd24b971bf13c877/research/p104-lean-invoice-binding/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de1bbd521b121479ffff4b7dfd24b971bf13c877/research/p104-lean-invoice-binding/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de1bbd521b121479ffff4b7dfd24b971bf13c877/research/p104-lean-invoice-binding/CREDITS.md). The formal source is `47ef383d7de8b77bd198b104c84efb06191a89c2`; the application source is `d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07`.

| Binding | Exact coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Main/helper distinction | All 1,262 main-mask bits equal the source owners; 400 mains excluded from 862 helper credits |
| Native ranks | Actual formal chart spans and every endpoint; 5,746 SPEC lattice distances per call |
| Caller data | Actual 2,048-call definition and both nine-entry caller tables |
| Complete invoice | Both full histograms agree rank by rank for all real exponents |
| Positive interval | `F(0)=169984`, integer slope bound `169886720`, endpoint lower bound `2432/25` |
| Controls | Seven changes to caller counts, call multiplicity, main credit, bank count, helper credit or main identity rejected |

For every integer rank `r >= 1`, set `b = bit_length(r-1)`. The proof uses `r <= 2^b` and `2^(-x) >= 1-x` for `x >= 0`. Thus the target-minus-paid margin satisfies `F(k) >= 169984 - 169886720 k`. This proves a whole nonempty interval without numerical powers, logarithms or root finding. `Valid` is an inequality, not equality at a crossing. No maximal interval is claimed.

This resolves the separate caller-invoice question left by [PR #7785](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7785). That graph audit's complete operator expansion is not repeated. The source graph builder runs, its canonical graph digest must match, and each rank is recomputed from binary chart spans. Equality to the application receipt binds the submitted data; it does not prove the physical caller chronology that produced the receipt.

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-lean-invoice-binding
```

Both modes print this prefix and elapsed seconds:

```text
PASS_P104_LEAN_INVOICE_BINDING 2048 calls 862 helpers 2432/25 margin 7 controls
```

All 49 retained files are authenticated. Normal/optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. The retained builder runs in normal Python in both modes; the new audit checks run in each declared mode. The retained CRLF credit file and source trailing space stay byte-exact; new files pass the whitespace check. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44464763829/job/135359769702) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

DreamingOfClouds (@DreamingOfClouds) supplied the [formal invoice definitions](https://github.com/DreamingOfClouds/integer-mult-bounds/blob/47ef383d7de8b77bd198b104c84efb06191a89c2/research/p104-banked-banner/lean/Nov15/BankPrem.lean), [caller instance](https://github.com/DreamingOfClouds/integer-mult-bounds/blob/47ef383d7de8b77bd198b104c84efb06191a89c2/research/p104-banked-banner/lean/Nov15/Bridge7761S2.lean), packed data and graph builder. Clear1nsight (@Clear1nsight) supplied the [application receipt](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/evidence/application.json). The native graph and edits come from Ali Romman (@aliromman) in [PR #7756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7756), as the source [credit record](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07/research/p104-mixed-batch-boundary/pr7756/CREDITS.md) states. The full retained notice directory preserves earlier credit.

The real-variable argument is an external mathematical proof; the finite binding is source-aware computational checking. No Lean proof term, kernel build, axiom audit, complete proof-closure review, physical realization, full caller chronology, ordinary BIT, outer assembly, stock or compiler replay is supplied. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. All five inherited assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8.
